analogy.boundary: The referee picture only rules out self-exemption; it says nothing about whether the referee's calls are right.

maps.analogy: the referee judging their own team
maps.doctrine: the system's own claims about itself

maps.analogy: the single rulebook that applies to everyone
maps.doctrine: the same tests as outside claims

maps.analogy: the referee's own match report, checked like any other
maps.doctrine: the pages that describe the system, held to the rules they describe

analogy.text: A referee cannot switch to an easier rulebook when the call involves their own team. The same rules apply.

reader.counterexample: A system publishes a self-assessment saying "verified and complete" that would fail the evidence rules it applies to the work it audits.
reader.does_not_prove: Holding its own documents to the same rules removes the exemption; the system's limits remain, now written down.

example.text: The release wording gate applies the same wording rules to the system's own public text as to any other text, and blocks overclaiming wording in the system's own pages.

reader.governs: Whether the system's own outputs are held to a lower standard.
reader.plain: The system holds its own statements about itself to the same standard it holds everyone else's. Being the one doing the checking earns it no discount.
reader.potential_misread: That applying the rules to itself makes the system trustworthy, when it only removes the exemption.
reader.refuses: An exemption for the system's own documents and tools.
reader.requires: That the system's own pages, validators, records and generated reports meet the same evidence and refusal rules as everything else.
reader.why_it_matters: When the system states its own limits, that statement is checked like any other.

data.statement:
Formal clause: for every Microcosm artifact `a`, any claim `phi` carried by `a`
must satisfy the same admissibility relation as external claims.

Lineage: reflective systems, self-hosting checks, no-special-pleading
evaluation.

Route: recorded as strongly witnessed by
`batch12_release_claim_language_gate`, `executable_doctrine_grammar`, release
export, the Crown Jewel self-scans and `evidence_truth_floor.py`. The tests
block overclaiming release language, leaks of result-record bodies, and claims
that the doctrine is complete. One layer-debt receipt is open: the evidence
truth floor does not yet block at the release boundary.

Anti-axiom: Microcosm's own files are exempt from the rules it applies to
everything else.
data.title: Reflexive accountability / no privileged meta-layer
